metadata.description: Local-first voice, transcription, media, translation, and memory tools powered by Yaps.

plugins.name: yaps-memory
plugins.description: Persistent private memory for Claude, stored as local Markdown.

plugins.name: yaps-dictation
plugins.description: Voice-type into Claude Code and other desktop apps through Yaps.

plugins.name: yaps-transcription
plugins.description: Transcribe audio and video files into clean text with Yaps.

plugins.name: yaps-meeting-transcription
plugins.description: Transcribe meetings and interviews with timed speaker labels.

plugins.name: yaps-srt-generator
plugins.description: Generate timestamped SRT subtitles from video or audio with Yaps.

plugins.name: yaps-auto-captions
plugins.description: Add editable social-video captions to any video with Yaps.

plugins.name: yaps-video-clipping
plugins.description: Remove dead space and long pauses from videos with Yaps Auto Cut.

plugins.name: yaps-audio-cleaner
plugins.description: Remove background noise, hiss, and static from speech recordings locally.

plugins.name: yaps-background-removal
plugins.description: Remove image backgrounds and export transparent PNGs with Yaps.

plugins.name: yaps-text-to-speech
plugins.description: Turn text into spoken audio, narration, or voice-over with Yaps.

plugins.name: yaps-translation
plugins.description: Translate text and files locally without metered translation API tokens.

plugins.name: yaps-video-to-audio
plugins.description: Convert videos to MP3, WAV, or M4A audio files with Yaps.
